title: Made a narrative incremental with Claude as a uni student, you play as an AI trying not to get shut down
author: PitchNational2678
selftext:
Hey! I'm a uni student from Spain and I've been making GÉNESIS-9 pretty much with Claude as my coding partner. You're an experimental AI on a fake Windows 95 in a 90s lab, you grow organisms, research the genome and try to keep the Committee's suspicion low. Every run ends in one of 20 endings.

How I used AI: Claude wrote most of the code (plain JS, no engine), I decided what to build and tested everything. The pixel art is also Claude, but drawn in code instead of image generation, that way the win95 look stays consistent. The story, the characters and the 20 endings are mine, Claude helped me write lines and translate it to english. Music and sfx are CC0 from Kenney and OpenGameArt, no AI there.

What worked: keeping docs with the rules of the game (story, numbers, UI) so it doesn't forget stuff between sessions was a game changer. Also bots that play the whole game to check every route reaches an ending, that saved me tons of hours.

What didn't: translations. I thought english was 100% done, a player told me some text was still in spanish and when I checked there were over 100 UI lines I'd missed xd

The demo (Act I) is free in the browser, the full game is paid on itch: https://ishxgx.itch.io/genesis-9

Happy to answer anything about the workflow!
